scope: Theory-only review of stronger controls for the existing eight unguarded primary operators; no new experimental round or outcome classification.
design_decision: GO for the compact G-RRR and PE-RRR controls plus the primary pooled-OLS numerical closure. The design addresses real identification alternatives; no mathematical necessity currently protects the full conditional output bank. This is not source or data-execution approval.
minimal_identification_set: Keep all eight preselected C32/r128/normal/unweighted/N120/guard100 local points unchanged.
Primary pooled eta values are zero: perform one matched two-stage numerical/lowering closure, not a new eta-by-lambda grid.
G-RRR: one expert-specific full-input slope factored into U,V, retaining the same contextual biases and actual Stage0 full-H decoded-A8 input design.
PE-RRR: one expert-specific U shared across leaves and conditional small B_c, using the same centered decoded-A8 low-rank design and fixed float shrink estimator.
Exactly q128 FP32 and q512 W8 main endpoints; q128 W8 and native-A8-latent execution remain explicitly predeclared diagnostics rather than a new rank/format search.
mathematical_closure: M_target correctly minimizes teacher FIT SSE only among output projections of the fixed float ridge predictions. It is not joint unrestricted unpenalized RRR, a deployed-quantization optimum, or a new theorem.
Use weighted within-leaf centered teacher Y and Z=actual decoded-A8 input minus its weighted leaf mean. Centered full-precision x does not imply centered quantized Z.
Preserve the fixed real-valued ridge estimator when constructing M; post-W8 predictions and recalibrated deployment biases require separate actual-arithmetic evaluation.

Freeze eigensolver, sign/tie policy and numerical-rank handling. Rank-at-most-q should not add directions with negative teacher-SSE benefit; any PSD claim retains the stated same-FIT weighted contraction assumptions.
G-RRR still uses contextual centers, biases and quantization. It is a global slope in those features, not a literal globally affine function of unquantized F32 x.

If a fixed-U oracle floor is reported for a W8 path, use the actual dequantized U column-space projector, such as U U-dagger, and that path's frozen biases. The ideal orthonormal U floor does not bound a different quantized span.
required_freeze_closures_before_executio: Declare exact host floating arithmetic separately from native integer/F32 order. All-host latents may remain floating point; do not impose a gratuitous second A8 quantizer.
Fix any FIT RMS gauge policy and its max-coordinate-RMS/16 floor. If two lowerings are retained, predeclare their role and VALID-only choice rather than select from SCORE.
Recalibrate biases from actual deployed FIT predictions using the original runtime input. Ideal centered algebra alone is insufficient.

Any N80 learning curve must reconstruct supervised U, M and slopes using only N80 teacher targets. Reusing N120 supervised U is not an N80 data-efficiency result; the existing unsupervised tree/P convention can remain separately disclosed.
Freeze the new finite comparisons, data-development labels, cost dimensions and source/build gate. Preserve the original Stage0 comparison family and results unchanged.
cost_and_falsification: Matching operator error with a smaller factor bank can falsify representational necessity of C full-output matrices for this finite family. It does not automatically falsify a systems advantage if host latency or other costs increase.

A systems dominance claim requires actual whole-bank residency, host traffic/compute, conversion, scales, biases, P/tree, non-FFN, shared placement, KV, workspace and cache behavior under both inclusive 8e9-byte and 8-GiB budgets. Zero NAND reads is not zero latency.

Keep EPYC pilot timings separate from target-host models and native AiF schedules. Eight cached operators do not reproduce a full-model working set; shared-branch placement and legal CPU/NAND overlap are symmetric choices.
Use prespecified paired prompt-level error comparisons on the same natural-route reference; no arbitrary percent cutoff or SCORE-based control reselection.

A successful G or PE point is an identification counterexample, not proof that its proposed causal explanation uniquely generated the observed gap. A failed fixed rank/precision point does not eliminate all global or common-output models.

Improving curves, wide or undefined bands, sparse routes, or crossed quality/resource frontiers remain limited or inconclusive. A credible local-bank Pareto point may advance within this same round without strict victory over every control on every metric.

The eight unguarded operators cannot dispose of other guarded points, complete mixtures, all layers or free-running quality. Publication value still requires a meaningful quality/latency/resource frontier beyond the strong controls; existing affine/RRR machinery is not itself novel.
